training_range_caveat: These are configured ranges, not proof of training sample coverage or generalization to the larger bed.

native_initial_image_difference.interpretation: Diagnostic only: native RTX temporal sampling can differ despite identical verified state, geometry, configuration and camera.

video.presentation: Synchronized from time zero; shared recorded duration only. Each panel resized equally to 960 pixels wide. Labels outside scene. No scene recoloring or camera changes.

task_variant.radius_definition: Volume-equivalent radius from unchanged grid density and resized lattice-cell dimensions
task_variant.heading_behavior: Native yaw quaternion retained; heading_command=False; no manual observation edits

metadata.container_walls: Resized native retaining/support geometry; see task_variant and variant_config.json
metadata.evaluation: MPM particle velocities supplied to independent force reconstruction; MPM feedback drives G1.
metadata.force_convention: World-frame force and torque about each foot body COM, order [Fx,Fy,Fz,Tx,Ty,Tz].
metadata.reference_timing: reference_wrench is generated this step; applied_wrench is lagged feedback entering this step.
metadata.jitter_definition: Full width in meters of independent per-axis uniform offsets [-jitter/2, jitter/2]
metadata.task_preservation: Explicit bed-size, command and spawn changes are recorded in task_variant. Native depth, material, grid resolution, viewer lighting/colors, actuation and reset distributions are retained. Geometry bounds, volume-equivalent particle radius and sparse capacities follow the resized bed. The supported workspace still includes the rigid approach platform.

estimator.surface_velocity_approximation: instantaneous COM twist; MPM uses forward finite rotation
estimator.input_velocity: MPM proxy input after lagged-wrench rewind; no additional gravity or actuation

rigid_ground_foot_force_definition.quantity: Force exerted by selected rigid ground shapes on each robot foot, world xyz, newtons
rigid_ground_foot_force_definition.timing: Last 0.0025 s rigid substep in each 0.005 s coupled step; not a substep average
rigid_ground_foot_force_definition.foot_order: Same order as foot_body_ids and estimated/reference wrenches
rigid_ground_foot_force_definition.state_effect: Diagnostic buffers only; does not change task contact observations or feedback

generalized_force_telemetry.coordinate_order: MJWarp generalized velocity order; includes floating-base coordinates
generalized_force_telemetry.timing: MJWarp buffers retained after the last 0.0025 s rigid substep of each 0.005 s coupled step; not a time average over the coupled step
generalized_force_telemetry.joint_force: Newton feed-forward effort before integration; native actuator forces are separate
generalized_force_telemetry.estimator_use: Diagnostics only; estimator receives proxy free motion and particle velocities

metadata.rigid_contact_count_definition: MJWarp nacon after the final rigid substep, all rigid contacts including self contact; excludes material-particle contacts

runs.velocity_material_phase_sampling: Pre-policy robot velocity held across that policy step's four physics intervals, then selected using the same >20 N reference-material-force mask
runs.direct_support_fraction_definition: Fraction of material-active physics intervals where either foot's direct rigid floor/platform force magnitude exceeds 20 N; force sampled after the last rigid substep

metadata.evaluation: MPM particle velocities supplied to independent force reconstruction; Estimated feedback drives G1; MPM supplies particle motion.
metadata.force_convention: World-frame force and torque about each foot body COM, order [Fx,Fy,Fz,Tx,Ty,Tz].
metadata.reference_timing: reference_wrench is generated this step; applied_wrench is lagged feedback entering this step.
metadata.jitter_definition: Full width in meters of independent per-axis uniform offsets [-jitter/2, jitter/2]
metadata.task_preservation: Explicit bed-size, command and spawn changes are recorded in task_variant. Native depth, material, grid resolution, viewer lighting/colors, actuation and reset distributions are retained. Geometry bounds, volume-equivalent particle radius and sparse capacities follow the resized bed. The supported workspace still includes the rigid approach platform.

estimator.surface_velocity_approximation: instantaneous COM twist; MPM uses forward finite rotation
estimator.input_velocity: MPM proxy input after lagged-wrench rewind; no additional gravity or actuation

rigid_ground_foot_force_definition.quantity: Force exerted by selected rigid ground shapes on each robot foot, world xyz, newtons
rigid_ground_foot_force_definition.timing: Last 0.0025 s rigid substep in each 0.005 s coupled step; not a substep average
rigid_ground_foot_force_definition.foot_order: Same order as foot_body_ids and estimated/reference wrenches
rigid_ground_foot_force_definition.state_effect: Diagnostic buffers only; does not change task contact observations or feedback

generalized_force_telemetry.coordinate_order: MJWarp generalized velocity order; includes floating-base coordinates
generalized_force_telemetry.timing: MJWarp buffers retained after the last 0.0025 s rigid substep of each 0.005 s coupled step; not a time average over the coupled step
generalized_force_telemetry.joint_force: Newton feed-forward effort before integration; native actuator forces are separate
generalized_force_telemetry.estimator_use: Diagnostics only; estimator receives proxy free motion and particle velocities

metadata.rigid_contact_count_definition: MJWarp nacon after the final rigid substep, all rigid contacts including self contact; excludes material-particle contacts

runs.velocity_material_phase_sampling: Pre-policy robot velocity held across that policy step's four physics intervals, then selected using the same >20 N reference-material-force mask
runs.direct_support_fraction_definition: Fraction of material-active physics intervals where either foot's direct rigid floor/platform force magnitude exceeds 20 N; force sampled after the last rigid substep

metric_definition: Within each run, RMS of foot force-vector error over both feet and physics steps when either foot's reference MPM material force magnitude exceeds 20 N. No-contact cases have null active-contact error.
scope: Reference versus estimated material feedback; MPM supplies particle dynamics in both. Native task geometry resized with native appearance and material settings retained.
validation: Verified all recorded state hashes, paired scene/checkpoint/initial-state equality, finite arrays, native material/resolution/appearance/actuation/reset and termination settings, particle bounds/mass/radius/count, command from time zero, and exact one-step feedback lag.
